hypothesis: Xiaomi-TabLDM (Apache-2.0 tabular large-data foundation model, in-context learning, SCM-synthetic pretraining + test-time scaling) adds fold-0 signal on the champion route view that the champion portfolio does not already extract: its equal-logit blend with route_ref beats route_ref by >= +5e-5 AUC with Spearman < 0.995.
why_distinct: First FLM-family screen of a post-TabPFN ICL architecture with a different pretraining distribution (structural causal models, not transformer-generated priors) and different inference mechanism (dual-stream feature grouping + Attention-Residual + sparse MoE, test-time ensemble scaling). Prior FLM screens: Mitra-v2 NEGATIVE, TabICL RESOURCE_BLOCKED, TabPFN v2.6/v3 deferred (champion is v3.5).

model_card.license: LICENSE file = Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2026 Xiaomi Corporation). NOTE (recorded contradiction): the README News bullet says 'Usage is subject to Xiaomi-TabLDM Non-Commercial License' but links to that same Apache-2.0 LICENSE file; the README footer states Apache-2.0. We treat the LICENSE file as operative and record the contradiction; competition rules govern eligibility, and the champion already relies on pretrained checkpoints under nonstandard licenses (TabPFN 'other').
model_card.pretraining_coverage: synthetic SCMs; context sizes hundreds to tens of thousands of rows; test-time compute scaling (n_estimators ensemble)
known_caveats: complexity O(n^2 + n m^2); full-FIT (560k) context infeasible -> stratified subsampled context arms
library bug 1: kv_cache=True conflicts with default enhance_candidates=True
library bug 2: enhance_candidates=True gaussian-rank perturbation broadcast error (train-noise sized vs eval rows) -> enhance_candidates=False
library bug 3: torch.cuda.set_device('cuda') indexless rejection -> device='cuda:0'

decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(candidate, route_ref)) - AUC(route_ref) on primary fold-0 (all 139927 rows)
decision_rule.also_reported: standard screen_metrics table vs champion portfolio (fold-0 AUC 0.961828) for comparability with the neural/FLM screen tables

anti_leakage: context rows drawn from FIT only (folds 1-4); fold-0 labels read only at final metric computation
route view is label-free (raw21 + coarse10, no target encoding)
TabLDM fit() updates no weights (in-context learning); its preprocessing is fitted on the FIT context only -> fold-safe
champion fold-0 references hash-asserted via load_champion_fold0; route_ref from the OOF store
checkpoint revision-pinned and sha256-asserted before fit
no disk offload (disk_offload_dir=None enforced; CPU offload allowed by the library's auto policy)

protocol.view: route (22 features: raw21 + coarse10) built by frames(tr, te, route=True)

arms.A_ctx20k: stratified 20000-row FIT context (phase-19 matched information budget, CONTEXT_SEED)
arms.B_ctx50k: stratified 50000-row FIT context (large-data regime; near the top of documented pretraining context coverage)

protocol.run_order: A then B; each arm writes its own report; a crashed arm does not block the other
